risks: Supplier cost unknown; no Odisha per-piece price was found. Marketplace price band is only Rs 800-1,699 for comparable tussar pieces, so the deal only works if a Puri/Raghurajpur workshop quotes about Rs 470-480 or less per piece for Amazon.in/Flipkart (Rs 620-640 for Shopify/Meesho)

Direct marketplace competition: Store Utsav sells the same format (Saura on tussar, unframed, paper border) at Rs 1,579 and other Amazon.in sellers at Rs 800. Price set at Rs 1,299, so lower than the Rs 1,579 comparable but above the Rs 800 floor seller

Close to already-explored Odisha GI crafts and the rejected talapatra palm-leaf pattachitra (RA-20261025D-1, rejected on Amazon.in price competition); the reviewer should decide whether painted tussar art counts as a repeat

'Hand-painted', 'natural colours' and 'GI-tagged' are claims that need supplier evidence (policy require_evidence_for_claims); printed-on-tussar copies and Rs 150 printed pieces exist. Do not use the GI tag unless the supplier is a registered authorised user
Must be sold unframed (rolled in a tube) to avoid glass; never offer a glazed frame (glass_fragile is blocked)
Handmade variation between pieces; 'not as pictured' returns unless photos show the actual piece or are clearly marked as representative. Supplier photos need written permission
Religious-themed designs (Jagannath, Krishna) need careful handling; Saura tribal designs avoid that
GST: hand paintings HSN 9701 assumed 5% after the 22-09-2025 rate changes (earlier 12%); textile-based painted articles may fall under a different HSN. CA to confirm
